summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi AGIX 2x Daily ETF (XAGI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the KraneShares Artificial Intelligence & Technology ETF (NASDAQ: AGIX), which provides exposure to global equities across the artificial intelligence value chain. XAGI was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
